sentences.en: He deliberately ignored me when I passed him in the street.
sentences.zh: 当他从我身边走过时，他故意忽视了我。

sentences.en: Remember that you are held liable for giving deliberately false testimony.
sentences.zh: 请记住，如果你提供了故意虚假的证词，你将承担法律责任。

sentences.en: She opened my messages and ignored them deliberately.
sentences.zh: 她打开我的信息并故意不予理会。

senses.zh: 慎重地；谨慎地故意地，蓄意地从容不迫地，不慌不忙地
